title: Relationships as typed directed edges
statement: The system shall store each relationship as a directed edge with a unique identifier, one type label, a source node, a target node and an optional nested property document, allowing multiple edges of the same type between the same pair of nodes.
rationale: Property-graph model; parallel edges needed for repeated relationships (e.g. multiple transactions between two accounts).

acceptance_criteria.text: Two edges of the same type between the same source and target are both stored and both returned by MATCH.
An edge with nested properties is returned unchanged by MATCH on its identifier.
